title: Improper access control in the Patch Management update mechanism of TeamViewer Full Client and Host for Windows prior…
description: A vulnerability in the Patch Management update mechanism of TeamViewer Full Client and Host for Windows prior to version 15.82 allows a local authenticated attacker with low privileges to execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges by supplying a signed executable through a forged IPC response that loads a malicious DLL from a user-writable temporary directory.
